ModMetaData.name: RimPunk CE
ModMetaData.author: Henry Frodsham
ModMetaData.description:
Cyberware, cyberpsychosis and stamina for Combat Extended. Operating systems (sandevistan, berserk, cyberdecks, chrome compressor), arm cyberware, prefrontal cortex implants and more, all tiered from T1 to Iconic.
Requires Royalty, Harmony and Combat Extended. Multiplayer compatible.
Icons by Lorc, Delapouite, Andy Meneely and Sbed from game-icons.net, CC BY 3.0, recoloured.
